R5.data: r1 6,009,681 + on-policy set O (packed batches listed x4)

R5-rep.role: treatment replicate, mandatory fit and games (C1, E1); no futility stop

R5W.data: r1 6,009,681 + matched off-policy set O_W (W vs v1, X decks, bank C_prime; root-matched to |O|), listed x4

recipe: R3a: init v1 d77005d5, width 192, root-only (teacher ratio 1), listwise T=0.003, play weight 1, value weight 0, advantage 0, AdamW 3e-4 wd .05, warmup 2000 + cosine, batch 8192, microbatch 3584, EMA 0.999, final EMA only; trainer exit-r3/source (freeze bc542da8), loader6/prefetch4, eager, bf16 autocast
calibration: R3 rule: threshold on P(gate=play) with a legal play nearest 34.6% deterministic root play on the 8,088 eligible roots of ExIt R1 held-out64 slice 0ecce0f0; midpoints between sorted distinct probabilities; smaller threshold on ties; label-free; GPU float32 TF32 off

compute.game_physical_cores: 0-49 (10 five-core K4S-120 slots, or 50 one-core S-200 lanes); SMT siblings unassigned

ordering.blocks: one game per block: each phase runs one arm for one student over all 1,200 indices in increasing order; K4S-120 phases use 5-core slots, S-200 phases 1-core lanes
ordering.interrupted: a game of an interrupted block is excluded; its seed is retired for every later phase and never re-run; reduction uses only seeds terminal in every reduced (student, arm)

readout.primary: Delta = mean(R5, R5-rep) minus mean(R3a, R3a-rep), paired by seed, pooled over K4S-120 and S-200 with equal arm weight; each arm also separately
readout.helps: upper95CI(Delta) < 0 AND pooled point(R5 minus R3a) < 0 AND pooled point(R5-rep minus R3a) < 0 (E2)
readout.secondaries: R5 minus R5W; mean(R5,R5-rep) minus R5W; single-fit contrasts; sigma_fit from R5 minus R5-rep and R3a-rep minus R3a (2-df, descriptive)
readout.decision: only the primary selects the decision-table row
readout.also: per-arm primary; parity table (E10, disclosed, no exclusion); contention-sensitivity primary (explicit no-estimate if empty); O-holdout diagnostic; O composition/dedup/600-tick duplicate table; O_W single-candidate share; cutoff/student-default/play/wall/overrun per student and arm
readout.stop_rule: fixed N=1200 for all five students (E1), no futility stop; no reduction before the C5 receipt is SHA-frozen and committed; hard-stop cut to the largest complete seed-index prefix (E8; R5W never cuts the primary); reporting block fit-free (C4)
readout.contention: flag a game if [mtime-wall, mtime] meets a bad census period: memory PSI avg10 > 10 or unreadable, foreign CPU > 2 cores host-wide outside the X4S-4 tree (R2-9) or unreadable, reduced concurrency (E7), or uncovered time; a phase launched below full workers flags all its games; union of flagged seeds excluded for all students; SHA-frozen and committed before reduction (C5)
readout.fit_inflated_interval: Delta +- 1.96*sqrt(SE_boot^2 + 0.65^2), sigma_fit fixed at 0.65 pp (E3); helps not robust to it is labelled so
readout.attribution: descriptive sub-label from the CI of mean(R5, R5-rep) minus R5W (E4); default: attribution unresolved

onpolicy.behavior: R3a student-tier agent in the X4S-3 deployment configs K4S-120 and S-200 on 127x01
onpolicy.capture: student-seat search decisions with >1 candidate, no preparation cutoff, no suspended belief, empty pre-decision (input) pending; every deadline hit + domain-separated 25% of non-hit
onpolicy.dedup: sha256(row arrays)+root_digest; first in order arm K4S-120,S-200; index; tick
onpolicy.teacher: W-screen8, K4 anchor kernel, no deadline (x4s qualify construction)
onpolicy.belief: opponent sampled from a deep copy of the deployed Belief (r1/G/O_W used ExactFastPrior; disclosed)

onpolicy_w.decks: X decks with the X4S index mapping own=g%5, opponent=(g//5)%5, seat=g%2
onpolicy_w.selection: smallest contiguous index prefix with roots >= |O|

students_order_rule: fixed ABBA order (E6), K4S-120 then S-200 per student; all phases only after the three fits are done and calibrated (C4)
